title: Phenol/Chloroform DNA Extraction Protocol with SDS Lysis Buffer
author: Mai-Britt Mosbech
materials: MaXtract High Density phase lock tube
Carefully remove supernatant, do not disturb the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tube
steps.instruction: Label a 2 ml Eppendorf safe-lock tube and fill it with 350 μl of working SDS lysis buffer.

steps.title: Add Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer sliced frozen tissue into the tube containing SDS lysis buffer using a scalpel, working quickly to prevent excessive thawing.

substeps.instruction: If tissue is very soft, use an Eppendorf pestle to squish tissue against the sides of the tube to break it up (do not use a rotating pestle or TissueRuptor with SDS lysis buffer).

steps.title: Initial Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl Puregen Proteinase K (2.5 mg/ml final concentration) to the tube.

steps.title: Incubate for Lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 50°C until all tissue has lysed (typically 30 minutes to 2 hours).

substeps.instruction: Shake at 900-1400 rpm for the first 10-15 minutes to improve lysis and reduce fragment size.
Reduce shaking to 300-450 rpm after the first 15 minutes until lysis is complete.

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Lower the temperature to 37°C and add 5 µl RNase A (10 mg/ml, final conc. 120 µg/ml).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C and 300 rpm for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Phase Lock Tube
steps.instruction: Label a 2 ml MaXtract High Density phase lock tube (Qiagen) and spin it for 20-30 seconds at 12,000-16,000 x g.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate
steps.instruction: Shortly spin the lysate tube to remove buffer from the cap, then transfer the lysate to the phase lock tube using a p1000 wide-bore tip set to 500 μl.

substeps.instruction: Avoid pipetting the fat layer if present.

steps.title: Add Salt and Organic Phase
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of 5 M NaCl (1 M final concentration) to the tube.

substeps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 400 μl of Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1).
To avoid dripping, fill and empty the tip 2-3 times before distributing the phenol:chloroform.

steps.title: Mix and Separate Phases
steps.instruction: Close tubes firmly and mix the organic and aqueous phases thoroughly to form a transiently homogeneous suspension.

substeps.instruction: Do not vortex; tube rotation (e.g., 20-30 rpm for 10 minutes) is acceptable.
Spin the sample for 10 minutes at 16,000 x g.

steps.title: Secondary Organic Extraction
steps.instruction: Carefully add 400 μl of Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (24:1) on top of the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Fill and empty the tip several times before distributing to prevent dripping.
Mix thoroughly without breaking the gel-seal to the organic phase (do not vortex; tube rotator at 20 rpm for 10 minutes is acceptable).
Spin for 10 minutes at 16,000 x g.

steps.title: Recover Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 450 μl of the aqueous phase to a new, labeled 2 ml tube and record the volume.

substeps.instruction: (Optional) To increase volume to 650 µl: add buffer A to the phase lock tube, mix without breaking the gel-seal, spin for 2-5 minutes at 12,000 x g, and transfer the additional aqueous phase to the new tube.

steps.title: Polysaccharide Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 0.3x volume of 99% ethanol and invert the tube 20 times to mix.

substeps.instruction: Spin the tube at maximum speed (at least 10,000 x g) for 15 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new labeled 2 ml tube, avoiding the polysaccharide pellet (even if not visible).

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1.7x volume of 99% ethanol (based on the volume transferred before the previous ethanol addition) and invert the tube 20 times to mix.

substeps.instruction: Spin the tube at maximum speed (at least 10,000 x g) for 30 minutes.
Add 1000 µl of freshly prepared 70% ethanol, avoiding dislodging the pellet.
Spin at maximum speed (at least 10,000 x g) for 5 minutes.
Repeat the ethanol addition and spin step one more time.

steps.title: Final Pellet Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a quick spin to gather residual ethanol at the bottom of the tube and remove it with a P20 tip.

substeps.instruction: Let the pellet air dry for 5 minutes at room temperature, ensuring it is not over-dried.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100-200 µl of resuspension buffer (preferred: Elution Buffer, lowTE, or TE).

substeps.instruction: Leave at room temperature with gentle mixing overnight to resuspend.
Alternatively, leave at 4°C or room temperature for 3-4 days to increase homogeneity before quality control.
